verdict.rationale: Pipedream documents MCP integration with a dedicated 'ai-frameworks' page, explicit examples for Vercel's AI SDK (chat app) and Claude's native MCP connector, plus generic 'automatic tool loading' client code, but the evidence never names LangChain, CrewAI, or the OpenAI SDK as documented adapters — only 'popular AI frameworks and LLMs' is claimed generically. missing for 10: explicit LangChain adapter docs, CrewAI adapter docs, OpenAI SDK integration example, independent confirmation these adapters work in practice.
